Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:13 -0700
Subject: OpenForge <> Redwood — connector interest and quick demo?

Hey Redwood team,

We just signed up and poked around the hosted API — really impressed with the batching and the quantization guidance. We're evaluating Redwood to power a GitHub Actions integration that lets OpenForge workflows call LLM-backed checks during CI.

A few quick details:
- We're running a mix of GitHub.com and a few self-hosted GHES instances behind a firewall.
- We'd like to understand auth options (OIDC vs PAT) and whether Redwood can run with our on-prem Dedicated/Private constraints.
- High-level ask: 30-minute walkthrough of the connector surface and deployment models.

Repo for context: https://github.com/openforge/service-connector

Can someone from sales/solutions confirm availability this week? Prefer afternoons PT.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Gupta
Head of Integrations, OpenForge
